query.text: 请帮我看看出门衣服是否适合现场可见的天气，有不合适的地方请告诉我并给出建议。
query.text_en: Please check whether my clothes suit the weather visible in the scene, and tell me about unsuitable choices with suggestions.

annotation.text_zh: 外面在下雨，建议选择深色裤子，不易弄脏。
annotation.text_en: Since it's raining outside, I'd suggest dark pants so they don't show dirt.

annotation.text_zh: 下雨天穿白鞋容易弄脏，建议换一双。
annotation.text_en: Better change your shoes, white ones will get dirty in the rain.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
